svg.title: Local dataset build from settings to exported teaching files
svg.desc: Local dataset build from settings to exported teaching files. Settings initialize the generation context, tables and master data precede operating activity, and accounting postings and year-end close precede validation, anomaly injection and file exports. This documents the local generator workflow; classroom users begin with the published files. Technical maintainer workflow. Classroom work begins with the published files; these are build steps, not business transactions.
